status: specification_only; production not started; future user request required
age_policy: Young appearance only; no separate aged variants

duplicate_gate.method: Aligned face-only ArcFace embeddings, fixed model/version/hash and L2 normalization; cosine similarity
duplicate_gate.action_if_at_or_above_threshold: Reject and regenerate candidate; re-run against every accepted prior identity, including all previous batches
duplicate_gate.calibration: Confirm threshold on the v6 pilot before bulk generation; log any threshold revision and regenerate/revalidate the full accepted set if changed
duplicate_gate.fallback: If using CLIP, use aligned face-only crop, fixed model and separately calibrated threshold; do not apply 0.35 to CLIP or embed the full jersey/background
duplicate_gate.real_person_policy: No real player/celebrity photo inputs or requested likeness. Embedding distinctness does not establish absence of resemblance to all real people; include visual review.

geometry.normalization: Match B reference pose/camera/background/lighting and normalize facial anchors before delivery; reject drift that breaks overlay alignment

sheets.coordinates: top-left pixel rectangle, no rotation; manifest includes sheet path, index, row, column, x, y, width, height for each identity

deployment_note: 10000 identities x 2 individual sizes = 20000 files before other game assets. Publish sheet files + manifest for Cloudflare, keep individual files in archive/storage rather than deploying both by default.
